scope: Event directory, not a calendar. Entries describe broad event purposes only.
verificationPolicy: No fixed dates, times, phases, eligibility thresholds, point values, or reward quantities are published. Check current in-game event panels and alliance announcements.

events.name: Alliance Duel / Alliance Versus
events.summary: A themed alliance competition that rewards coordinated participation and actions matched to the active task list.
events.preparation: Save relevant progression materials until the live daily theme and eligible actions are confirmed.

events.name: Full Preparedness
events.summary: A recurring preparation activity with task themes that may overlap with other progression events.
events.preparation: Read the active task panel before spending. Do not rely on an old clock conversion or rotation table.

events.name: Canyon Clash
events.summary: An alliance-versus-alliance battlefield activity built around coordinated objectives and team roles.
events.preparation: Confirm the current registration list, match time, commander assignments, map objectives, and rules with alliance leadership.

events.name: Battle for the Capital
events.summary: A capital-control competition where alliance coordination and territory pressure are central to the outcome.
events.preparation: Confirm the active event rules, battle window, entry conditions, and alliance plan in-game.

events.name: Server War (SvS)
events.summary: A cross-server competition whose preparation and battle rules can depend on the current season and server pairing.
events.preparation: Use the live phase objectives and your server leadership's instructions; do not assume a previous season's scoring applies.

events.name: Zombie Tyrant
events.summary: An alliance-coordinated boss activity focused on contributing damage and following the scheduled rally plan.
events.preparation: Confirm the scheduled start, rally instructions, participation rules, and current reward criteria with R4/R5.

events.name: Shooting Loot
events.summary: A reward event that uses its own event currency and prize selection. Exact shot guarantees and milestone rewards are not reproduced here.
events.preparation: Read the current event rules and compare the available rewards before using saved event currency or premium currency.

events.name: Bullseye Booty
events.summary: A reward-focused event referenced in the existing LZ Carry event index. Current mechanics and reward milestones need a fresh in-game check.
events.preparation: Check the live rules, currency sources, reward path, and event end time before spending.

events.name: Fury Lord
events.summary: A boss and damage-contribution activity referenced in the existing LZ Carry event topics. Detailed mechanics are not yet cleared for publication.
events.preparation: Confirm the current boss rules, scoring conditions, and alliance coordination plan in-game.

events.name: Hero Battlefield
events.summary: A competitive hero-focused activity retained from the existing LZ Carry event topic list. Current format and scoring need in-game verification.
events.preparation: Review the current event panel and avoid assuming hero restrictions or scoring from earlier seasons.
